messages:
tess: Quick heads-up — small rollout planned: 4.0.2 (batching kernel tweak + telemetry opt-in). Target window Wed 06:00 PT. Need: short RN copy for internal, pin snippet, canary cadence, and an explicit evacuation (rollback) checklist. @omar can you own ops?

omar: I got this. Propose canary phases: 10% (20m) -> 40% (25m) -> 100% (gradual ramp). Health gates: error-rate, p95 latency, and sampling of QA prompt set for quality drift. If any gate fails we abort and fallback to 4.0.1.

sylvia: I'll craft micro RN. Plan: 1-line summary + 2 bullets (what changed, impact) + revert steps. Keep audience: ENG + SRE.

tess: For comms: please add a single-sentence exec summary for #all-hands copy. Something like: "Perf micro-update; low risk; canary-first rollout."

deploybot: Preflight initiated for release 4.0.2
```
Preflight:
- infra: OK
- migrations: none
- smoke: 11/11 PASS
- canary hooks: yes
- quota/limits: OK
```

omar: Rollback thresholds (suggested):
- error-rate >= 2x baseline for 5m OR
- latency p95 >= 2.5x baseline for 5m OR
- QA regression on sampled prompts (>= 10% failure)
On abort: immediate pin to 4.0.1 + disable new batching path.

sylvia: Draft RN microcopy:
```
4.0.2 (micro): kernel batching tweaks to reduce short-prompt tail latency (~10%). No API changes. Pin: 4.0.2. Rollback: automatic fallback to 4.0.1 and disable batching path if canary shows increased errors or QA regressions.
```

tess: Nice. Minor edit: change "automatic fallback" -> "automatic fallback and telemetry off" so ops can re-enable later. Add one-liner for #all-hands: "Perf-focused microblast; canary-first; minimal customer exposure."

omar: Ops runbook (copy/paste):
```
# Pin service version
curl -X POST https://internal-api/release/pin -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"service":"inference","version":"4.0.2"}'
# Abort + rollback
deployctl abort --release 17788 && deployctl rollback --service inference --version 4.0.1
# Disable batching path
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/toggle -d '{"flag":"new_batching_path","state":"off"}'
```

deploybot: Rollout schedule set: Wed 2026-03-25 06:00 PT -> 10% (20m) -> 40% (25m) -> 100% ramp. Dashboard: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rollouts/17788

omar: I'll monitor first 45m. Silvia (QA), please run quick sample checks after each canary step. Escalation: ping @tess and @sylvia, then paging SRE channel if thresholds hit.

sylvia: Will post RN in this channel + attach manifest snippet by EOD today. I'll also add the QA sample list. :white_check_mark:

tess: Thanks. When RN is posted here, I'll give final sign-off and tag #all-hands-announce. If any preflight issue shows up we hold and re-eval.

omar: A few reminders: add `pin_version: \"4.0.2\"` to the release manifest before 05:30 PT and ensure alerting runs with the new thresholds.

deploybot: Reminder: run `deployctl dry-run --release 17788` by 05:45 PT on rollout day.

sylvia: Understood — drafting now, will attach by 17:00 PT.

tess: Closing — final signoff when RN posted here.
